An endurance test reserved exclusively for 200 runners chosen to take on the little-known trails and ridges of the Valle d'Aosta, to add a spark of adventure to the competition aspect.
Most of the trail's 450k route is along the forgottent Alte Vie 3 and 4 of the Aosta Valley in Italy
